summary: Tested GoGreat backend APIs (health-scan + contact CRUD/validation) and frontend flows (home hero, navbar routing, 8-step health scan flow with validation and success, contact form validation + submission, about + service pages). Backend: 10/10 pytest passed. Frontend: all critical flows work end-to-end (POST /api/health-scan returns 200 and shows scan-success; POST /api/contact returns 200 and shows contact-success; empty submit shows sonner validation toast on both forms). One duplicate data-testid issue found on Contact page.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid: `contact-phone` and `contact-email` are applied to both the info-card <a> elements (contact-${label.toLowerCase()}) AND the form <input> elements. Playwright's page.fill('[data-testid=contact-phone]') resolves to the anchor first and fails. Also breaks any downstream test/analytics scoped by these testids.

issues: Sonner success toast renders in the top-center overlapping the navbar links (Home/Vaniga Nala Aayvu/About/Contact) — reduces readability of navbar during the toast display window.

action_items: Rename the info-card testids on Contact.jsx (line ~83-85) to something like `contact-info-${label.toLowerCase()}` so the form inputs `contact-phone`/`contact-email` remain uniquely selectable.
Optionally reposition sonner Toaster (e.g. top-right) so success toast does not overlap navbar links.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx uses dynamic testids `contact-${label.toLowerCase()}` for info cards which collide with the form input testids (`contact-phone`, `contact-email`). Namespace them.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('shutdown'); consider lifespan handler (non-blocking).
HealthScan/Contact do no phone-format validation client-side — acceptable per spec (only presence required) but note for future.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed docs in mongo collections health_scans and contacts via API during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 4 endpoints + validation + persistence. Duplicate testid on Contact page requires scoping selectors to `[data-testid='contact-form'] [data-testid='contact-phone']` until fixed. Lenis smooth-scroll is active but did not interfere with any interactions in this run.
rca of the issue: In Contact.jsx (line ~83) the info cards are rendered with `data-testid={`contact-${d.label.toLowerCase()}`}`. Two of those labels are 'Phone' and 'Email', producing the same testids as the form inputs `contact-phone` / `contact-email` on the same page. Fix: rename the info-card testids to `contact-info-phone`, `contact-info-email`, etc., or scope form testids like `contact-form-phone`.
